response.justification: Bogdan has over 10 years of full-stack experience with deep proficiency in TypeScript, Node.js, React, and cloud tools like AWS CDK and Docker, directly matching the required stack. His work on AI-agent infrastructure and open-source tooling demonstrates relevant innovation, and his extensive testing, architecture, and DevOps contributions align strongly with the role’s responsibilities. Minor concerns include limited explicit mention of Nest.js, Vitest, or Kotlin/Java in recent roles, but his adaptability and breadth compensate.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience with TypeScript, Node.js, and React across multiple enterprise contexts
Proven expertise in AI-agent systems, testing frameworks, and DevOps tooling (Docker, CI/CD, GitLab)
Strong track record of building scalable, user-focused systems and contributing to open-source infrastructure
concerns: No explicit mention of Nest.js or Vitest in recent roles — though equivalent frameworks are used
Limited evidence of Kotlin/Java usage in last 5 years despite being a secondary requirement
German language proficiency is only basic, which may hinder collaboration in a Berlin-based enterprise team
